title: SandMuon: Diagonal Sensitivity-Weighted Muon with Compensated S8
description:
SandMuon is a standalone PyTorch package for diagonal sensitivity-weighted Muon. It combines diagonal activation second moments and squared real-loss output cotangents, an analytic rank-one activation-mean correction, and an S8 spectral map.

This archive includes a portable eager FP32 reference, the historical GPU implementation, compact run evidence, and the preliminary manuscript Sand-Muon: Inexpensive Sensitivity Geometry for Spectral Optimization, by Hamza Kharbouch.

The manuscript reports a single-seed 103M-parameter FineWeb-Edu case study. The comparison recipes differ in momentum, polarization, auxiliary optimizer, and schedule. These whole-recipe observations do not isolate the optimizer's effect or establish general superiority. The portable FP32 implementation differs numerically and in speed from the archived BF16 GPU implementation.

Source repository: https://github.com/pxike/SandMuon.
